title: projects.yaml v2 schema + idempotent migration
details: PRD §6.6. Fields: version, name, path, status (active|stale|archived), priority (high|medium|low), cron, added_at, skills[], budget_tokens_monthly, budget_tokens_per_run, notes. Migration detects v1 by absent 'version' field, fills defaults, backs up original to projects.yaml.v1.bak. Idempotent: second run is no-op.
